changes.to: Maker page: two 7-DOF arms on an omnidirectional base with a motorized lifting column; compliant force-controlled actuators with force sensing at every joint; up to 20 kg hugged between both arms; VR demonstration teaching; stack runs onboard. Height, weight, speed, battery and total DoF are not published.
Compliant dual-arm mobile manipulator that works beside people without fencing for carton, tote and line-side handling.
